description_en: Creates a compliance package for the current account
description_zh: 为当前账号创建合规包
kebab_example: aliyun config create-compliance-pack --compliance-pack-name '等保三级预检合规包' --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package template.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包模板ID。

关于如何获取合规包模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the compliance package
parameters.name: compliance_pack_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the compliance package
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2 (default): medium risk.
3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2（默认值）：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

fields.help_en:
The ID of the rule. Cloud Config adds the existing rule to the current compliance package.

You must specify either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If both parameters are specified, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
规则ID。配置审计将已有规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确
fields.name: config_rule_id

fields.example: 弹性IP实例带宽满足最低要求
fields.name: config_rule_name

fields.help_en:
The name of the rule parameter.

The `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` parameters must be specified together or left empty at the same time. If the rule template has parameters without default values, you must specify these parameters
fields.help_zh:
规则参数名称。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认值，则您必须设置该参数
fields.name: parameter_name

fields.help_en:
The value of the rule parameter.

The `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` parameters must be specified together or left empty at the same time. If the rule template has parameters without default values, you must specify these parameters
fields.help_zh:
规则参数值。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认值，则您必须设置该参数
fields.name: parameter_value

fields.help_en: The information about the rule parameters
fields.name: config_rule_parameters

fields.example: 弹性公网已绑定到ECS或者NAT实例，非闲置状态，视为“合规”。
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The identifier of the rule template. Cloud Config automatically creates a rule based on the rule template identifier and adds the rule to the current compliance package.

You must set either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If both parameters are set, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
规则模板标识。配置审计根据规则模板标识自动创建规则，并将该规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确
fields.name: managed_rule_identifier

fields.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: high risk.
2: medium risk.
3: low risk
fields.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
fields.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The list of rules in the compliance package.

You must specify either this parameter or `TemplateContent`
parameters.help_zh:
合规包中的规则列表。

本参数和`TemplateContent`必须设置其中一个
parameters.name: config_rules

parameters.help_en:
The template information used to generate the compliance package. You can view the template content from the details API of an existing compliance package, or refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2659733.html to compose the template.

You must specify either this parameter or ConfigRules
parameters.help_zh:
用于生成合规包的模板信息。模板内容可以从已有合规包详情API中查看，或者参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2659733.html进行编写。

本参数和ConfigRules必须设置其中一个
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The `ClientToken` value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the rule supports quick enablement. Valid values:
true: The rule is enabled when the compliance package is quickly enabled.
false (default): The rule is not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则是否支持快速启用。取值：
true：合规包快捷启用时会开启该规则。
false（默认值）：不启用
parameters.name: default_enable

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified region IDs. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The excluded region IDs. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 排除的地域范围，多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package does not take effect on the specified resource IDs, which means the resources are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs for which the compliance package takes effect. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 生效的资源范围，多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified resource group IDs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package does not take effect on resources in the specified resource group IDs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源不生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键的资源生效
parameters.name: tag_key_scope

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key-value pair.
TagValueScope must be used together with TagKeyScope
parameters.help_zh:
合规包仅对绑定指定标签键值对的资源生效。
TagValueScope需结合TagKeyScope一起使用
parameters.name: tag_value_scope

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource
fields.name: tag_key

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

You can bind up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

You can bind up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can bind up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package
